mode-operator {{ .Chart.AppVersion }} is installed in namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }}.

Check that it is running:
  kubectl -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} get deploy {{ include "mode-operator.controllerName" . }}

Next:
{{- if not .Values.definitions }}
  1. Create a ClusterModeDefinition listing the allowed modes, or set the
     chart's definitions value.
{{- else }}
  1. Definitions installed: {{ range .Values.definitions }}{{ .name }} {{ end }}
{{- end }}
  2. Install the mode manager and bind its ServiceAccount to the
     {{ include "mode-operator.resourceName" (dict "suffix" "clustermode-writer" "context" .) }} ClusterRole. It creates the ClusterMode.
     Maintainers who may change the mode by hand need
     {{ include "mode-operator.resourceName" (dict "suffix" "clustermode-maintainer" "context" .) }}.
  3. Opt workloads in with the mode.bitasylum.org/clustermode label and the
     mode.bitasylum.org/replicas annotation.

Then watch it with:
  kubectl get clustermode -o wide

The CRDs{{ if .Values.definitions }} and definitions{{ end }} stay in place on helm uninstall. Deleting a CRD
deletes every object of its kind.
